newsitem.title: USA: Dayton Hudson Sept same store sales off.
newsitem.headline: Dayton Hudson Sept same store sales off.

text.p: Dayton Hudson Corp said Thursday its September same store sales decreased 1.3 percent compared to a year ago.
Net retail sales for the five weeks ended October 5 rose six percent to $2.13 billion from $2.01 billion a year ago.
"Sales at all three divisions were somewhat below plan for the month of September," Bob Ulrich, chairman, said in a statement.

Dayton said its Target division's total sales for the month increased 10.2 percent and comparable-store sales increased 0.9 percent. Year-to-date, Target's total sales rose 15.9 percent and comparable-store sales gained seven percent.

Mervyn's total sales for the month decreased 5.2 percent and comparable-store sales fell 6.8 percent. Year-to-date, Mervyn's total sales decreased 0.3 percent and comparable-store sales declined 2.4 percent.

The Department Store Division's total sales for the month increased 0.1 percent and comparable-store sales decreased 4.9 percent. Year-to-date, the Department Stores total sales decreased 1.3 percent and comparable-store sales declined 3.9 percent.

Total company sales for the 35 weeks ended October were $14.967 billion, up 10.5 percent from $13.545 billion in the same period a year ago. Comparable-store sales for the 35-week period were up 3.7 percent compared to the same period last year.
